title: Download all-match salesman commission currency summary as Chinese PDF
description: Add a separate summary PDF action and POST export-summary-pdf endpoint. Rebuild fresh authorized bounded evidence using the same request/summary rules as summary Excel, independent of previous preview/current page/selected detail fields. New narrow DynamicSalesCommissionSummaryPdfExporter uses existing PDFsharp and existing local SimHei resolution, direct controller call, no package/DI/config/font-asset writes. Fixed finite raw-currency summary rows show signed known amount/counts and unknown completeness/profit/payout/current-reference-rate evidence; include full normalized date/filter/all-match coverage/source cap/global distinct bucket/order counts/source/currency/current-reference/unknown historical-cost context. Summary never includes employee detail rows, unselected detail columns, cross-currency grand monetary totals or claimed earned payouts. Repeat headers across row/column pages, preserve currency/coverage identity and avoid overlap/clipping; explicitly fail font-unavailable/render errors instead of empty or missing-glyph success. Designer preserves detail state and displays summary download failures. Existing detail PDF remains current-page only. Verify bytes/text/page structure where supported plus deterministic render/layout inputs, not screenshots or real browser acceptance. Development only. Reuse existing sales-commission menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted SalesOrders, <=366-day inclusive date window and fail-closed 500-order source cap, and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Each endpoint validates its current request and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope; invalid input, revoked authorization or overflow returns no data/file. Employee identity is an order attribute, not a permission boundary. Known original-currency signed order amounts remain separate; invalid raw currencies are distinct count-only unknown-amount groups. Historical Profit, ProfitRate and CommissionAmount remain null with reasons, including configured zero current reference rate; current SalesCommissionRate is not a historical agreement, earned payout, customer agency fee or ledger posting. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated summary PDF endpoint rebuilds the same all-match bounded evidence with fresh identity/menu/customer scope and current-request validation, independent of preview/page/selected detail fields.
Chinese PDF uses finite currency summaries with explicit unknowns and mandatory context, repeated headers/page coverage and clear font/render failures, without unsupported details/totals.

Designer summary PDF download preserves detail/filter/page state and handles errors; PDF/controller/UI tests cover scope, cap, page independence, signed/unknown/zero evidence and safe build/test passes.
